sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.

3. The Petitioners are in custody since 14.05.2024 in connection with C.T. Case No. 70 of 2016 arising out of Udala P.S. Case No. 132 of 2016 pending in the Court of the learned P.O. Special Court under POCSO Act, Mayurbhanj, Baripada, for the alleged commission of the offences under sections 363/366-A/294/376(2)(n)/376-D of I.P.C., read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

4. As it appears the petitioners were earlier granted bail by the Court below but because of their default in appearance before the trial Court, NBW was issued pursuant to which, they surrendered to custody voluntarily.
5. Since the petitioners were earlier granted bail considering the merits of the case and have voluntarily surrendered to custody, I am inclined to release them on bail.
